Publish to a practice lesson

Check the destination, review the exact save in the companion, then verify its receipt.

Return to lesson workspace

1. Approved lesson

Open this screen from an approved lesson, or select its exported review package.

2. Check the saved destination

In your practice lesson’s companion, choose Open reusable lesson transfer, confirm the destination, and choose Read baseline only and download report. This reads the lesson without staging or saving.

Match revised objectives

Choose which imported objective belongs to each saved record. Its identity and level tags stay attached. Every imported objective must be used once.

3. Review and save with the companion

Use companion version 0.14.0 or newer. The package below is bound to the checked destination and its saved content. If either changes, preparation stops. The companion rereads the lesson, rehearses supported changes, restores the editor, and presents the exact save for approval.

Complete the destination check first.

Open checked practice lesson

In that lesson’s companion, load this package, inspect every proposed change, then approve and save once. Keep the automatically downloaded report. An uncertain save is rechecked without resending.

4. Verify the saved result

A success message alone does not establish that your lesson was saved. This step independently checks the report against your approved package.

Start a separate publication review
